     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocusNative
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract
    10	
    11	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
    12	This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
    13	always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
    14	`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
    15	arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
    16	explicit obligations.
    17	
    18	The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
    19	second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
    21	through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    42	
    43	/-! ## The native adapter contract -/
    44	
    45	/--
    46	A lambda-tied rank-one presentation whose module is canonically the native module of its
    47	cocycle datum.
    48	
    49	The fields after `datum_class` are exactly the remaining producer obligations.  The line-bundle
    50	certificate is derived from the canonical piece trivializations, so a field-level H⁰/H¹
    51	calculation or an unrelated line bundle cannot be silently substituted for the native
    52	evaluation module.
    53	-/
    54	structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    55	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    56	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    57	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    58	  represents :
    59	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    60	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    61	  datum_class :
    62	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    63	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    64	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    65	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    66	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    67	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    68	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    69	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    70	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
    71	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    72	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    73	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    74	  h0_rank_one :
    75	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    76	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    77	
    78	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    79	
    80	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    81	
    82	/-- Convert the native adapter contract to the existing local-presentation contract.
    83	
    84	The two native bridge fields are inserted definitionally; all other fields are transported
    85	without weakening or adding hypotheses.
    86	-/
    87	noncomputable def toLocalPresentation
    88	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    89	    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam :=
    90	  { cover := P.cover
    91	    representative := P.representative
    92	    represents := P.represents
    93	    datum := P.datum
    94	    datum_class := P.datum_class
    95	    module := P.datum.nativeModule
    96	    module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso
    97	    line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle
    98	    native_pushforward_base_change := P.native_pushforward_base_change
    99	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
   100	    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
   101	    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
   102	    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }
   103	
   104	theorem nonempty_localPresentation
   105	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
   106	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :=
   107	  ⟨P.toLocalPresentation⟩
   108	
   109	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   110	
   111	/-! ## Immediate rank-one-locus consumer -/
   112	
   113	/--
   114	An arbitrary-affine family of native contracts supplies the existing public rank-one-locus
   115	consumer.  The family is quantified in exactly the same way as
   116	`PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition`; the conversion only canonicalizes the module
   117	choice and does not manufacture any of the remaining geometric certificates.
   118	-/
   119	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations
   120	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   121	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   122	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   123	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
   124	        Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   125	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
   126	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   127	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi
   128	  intro A _ _ t
   129	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
   130	  exact P.nonempty_localPresentation
   131	
   132	end AlgebraicGeometry

     5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus
     6	
     7	/-!
     8	# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum
     9	
    10	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
    11	ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
    12	modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
    13	that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
    14	`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
    15	`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
    16	restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.
    17	
    18	The canonical piece trivializations also prove that the native module is a line
    19	bundle.  Pushforward base-change and existence of a tied
    20	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` remain genuine producer obligations.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    32	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    34	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    35	
    36	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    41	
    42	/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.
    43	
    44	The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
    45	are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
    46	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    47	    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    48	      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
    49	  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    50	    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
    51	  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    52	      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    53	    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
    54	  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    55	    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    56	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    57	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    58	    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)
    59	
    60	/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
    61	noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
    62	  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    63	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
    64	  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    65	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    66	    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
    67	  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    68	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
    69	  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    70	    intro X Y f r m
    71	    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
    72	        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
    73	      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
    74	        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
    75	        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
    76	    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
    77	    apply Subtype.ext
    78	    funext j
    79	    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    80	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])
    81	
    82	/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/
    83	noncomputable def nativeModule : (relCurve C B).Modules := by
    84	  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
    85	  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
    86	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
    87	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    88	    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    89	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    90	    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
    91	  all_goals rfl
    92	
    93	/-! ## Piecewise line-bundle trivializations -/
    94	
    95	/-- Sections of the native module over one cocycle piece are the structure-ring sections.
    96	
    97	The open-immersion ring equivalence transports the component trivialization from the ambient
    98	relative curve to the restricted scheme.  The `gluedTriv_gluedQsmul` identity is exactly the
    99	structure-sheaf semilinearity needed for this to be a linear equivalence over the restricted
   100	ring of sections. -/
   101	noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv
   102	    (j : D.index) (V : (D.pieces j).toScheme.Opens) :
   103	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) ≃ₗ[
   104	      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) := by
   105	  let e := gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
   106	  let ρ := ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   107	  let f : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) →ₗ[
   108	      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) :=
   109	    { toFun := fun s => ρ (e s)

   120	/-! ## The Hilbert polynomial of a coherent sheaf
   121	
   122	The Hilbert polynomial `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.hilbertPolynomial` is constructed in
   123	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.HilbertPolynomial` (imported above): it is the unique
   124	`Φ_{F,s} ∈ ℚ[λ]` agreeing for `m ≫ 0` with the graded Hilbert function
   125	`m ↦ dim_{κ(s)} Γ(X_s, F_s ⊗ L_s^{⊗m})` of the fibre section module. This is the `H⁰`-only
   126	encoding; it agrees with the Euler-characteristic form `χ(F(m))` by Serre vanishing, for
   127	proper `X_s` and ample `L_s`. See `Scheme.hilbertPolynomial_eq_of_eventually` for uniqueness
   128	and `Scheme.existsUnique_hilbertPolynomial_of_isRatHilb` for existence, the latter resting on
   129	the graded Hilbert–Serre theorem of `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GradedHilbertSerre`.
   130	
   131	Reference: Nitsure §1; cf. Hartshorne III.5.2. -/
   132	
   133	/-! ## The Quot functor, the Grassmannian, and representability
   134	
   135	The functor definitions `Scheme.QuotFunctor` and `Scheme.Grassmannian` — Setoid quotients of
   136	families of quotients, with their pullback functoriality — and the representability statements
   137	`Scheme.Grassmannian.representable` and `Scheme.QuotScheme` live in
   138	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuotFunctorDef`. That functor-of-points layer consumes the
   139	flattening-stratification flatness predicate `Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat`, the support and
   140	freeness predicates built below in this file, and the Hilbert-function machinery of
   141	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.HilbertPolynomial`, so it sits above this file,
   142	`FlatteningStratification` and `GlueDescent` in the import order. -/

   145	/-! ## Cohomology and base change
   146	
   147	The Quot construction uses cohomology and base change in two places: the boundedness step
   148	(Nitsure §5, "Use of m-regularity") and the Grassmannian embedding (Nitsure §5, "Embedding
   149	Quot into Grassmannian").
   150	
   151	Stacks 02KH states flat base change for all higher direct images `R^i f_*` of quasi-coherent
   152	sheaves. What is proved here is the `i = 0` form on `Scheme.Modules`, the substantive content
   153	of part (ii) of that statement; the `R^i` form for `i ≥ 1` is not proved. -/
   154	
   155	/-! ### Flat base change of cohomology (Stacks tag 02KH, `i = 0` form)
   156	
   157	Let
   158	```
   159	   g'
   160	X' ───→ X
   161	│       │
   162	f'      f
   163	↓       ↓
   164	S' ───→ S
   165	   g
   166	```
   167	be a cartesian square of schemes with `g` flat and `f` quasi-compact
   168	quasi-separated. Let `F` be a sheaf of `O_X`-modules. Then the canonical
   169	base-change map `g* (f_* F) ⟶ f'_* ((g')* F)` is an isomorphism in
   170	`S'.Modules`.
   171	
   172	(The full Stacks 02KH statement covers all higher direct images
   173	`R^i f_* F` for `i ≥ 0`; what is proved here is the `i = 0` form, the
   174	substantive content of part (ii) of that statement.)
   175	
   176	The base-change natural transformation itself is the mate of the
   177	`pullback ⊣ pushforward` adjunction (Mathlib's `mateEquiv` applied to
   178	`Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction`); that it is an isomorphism
   179	is `canonicalBaseChangeMap_isIso`. The deep content (Stacks 02KH / 02KE /
   180	00H8) lies entirely in that step: it reduces affine-locally to the claim
   181	that, for a flat ring map `A → B`, the canonical map
   182	`B ⊗_A H^i(X, F) → H^i(X_B, F_B)` is an isomorphism for quasi-coherent
   183	`F`, here in its `i = 0` form. The affine-local reduction runs through the
   184	section formula of Stacks 01HQ (`pullback_app_isoTensor`) and a
   185	quasi-compact open-cover Mayer–Vietoris induction. -/
   186	
   187	/-- The canonical base-change natural transformation `g* (f_* -) ⟶ f'_* ((g')* -)`
   188	associated to a cartesian square
   189	```
   190	     g'
   191	X' ─────→ X
   192	│         │
   193	f'        f
   194	↓         ↓
   195	S' ─────→ S
   196	     g

   204	This natural transformation always exists (no flatness needed). The

   206	*isomorphism* claim under the hypotheses

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/

    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)

    89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)

   115	/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
   116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
   119	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶

   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
   128	
   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
   130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
   141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
   142	    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)

   144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
   145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
   154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
   155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
   156	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   158	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   159	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)

   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
   209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module

     9	/-!
    10	# Base change of the two-term complex and of `H¹` on the relative curve
    11	
    12	CBC-1/2 for the structure sheaf, bundled: for the curve bundle `C` over a field `k`, a
    13	tower of test rings `R → R'` (commutative `k`-algebras) and the base-changed affine
    14	two-cover `relCover C R D` of the relative curve `C_R`, this file base-changes the
    15	two-term Čech complex `Γ(V₀ᴿ) × Γ(V₁ᴿ) → Γ(V₀ᴿ ⊓ V₁ᴿ)` along `R → R'` and deduces the
    16	degree-one comparison isomorphism — Kleiman's "cohomology commutes with base change" in
    17	the curve-lite two-cover form.
    18	
    19	* `LinearMap.quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv` — the general right-exactness input: base change
    20	  commutes with cokernels, `A ⊗[R] (N ⧸ range f) ≃ₗ[A] (A ⊗[R] N) ⧸ range (f.baseChange A)`.
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relTermBaseChange` — **CBC-1, termwise**: for a qcqs open
    22	  `V ⊆ C.left`, the `R'`-linear equivalence
    23	  `R' ⊗[R] Γ(C_R, V_R) ≃ₗ[R'] Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})`, with the computation rule
    24	  `relTermBaseChange_tmul` (`r' ⊗ y ↦ r' • relSectionsMap y`).
    25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relDiffBaseChange` — **CBC-1, the complex**: the base change of the
    26	  two-cover restriction-difference map `TwoCover.diff` over `R` is carried to the
    27	  difference map over `R'` under the term equivalences (the commuting square).
    28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relH1CokBaseChange` — **CBC-2 (`i = 1`), cokernel form**:
    29	  `R' ⊗[R] H1Cok R (C_R) ≃ₗ[R'] H1Cok R' (C_{R'})`, unconditionally in `R → R'` (the
    30	  cokernel of a base-changed complex is the base change of the cokernel; no flatness).
    31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relH1BaseChange` — **CBC-2 (`i = 1`)**: the same statement on the
    32	  cohomology carriers, `R' ⊗[R] H¹(C_R, 𝒪) ≃ₗ[R'] H¹(C_{R'}, 𝒪)`, through the landed
    33	  relative two-cover identification `relTwoCoverH1`.
    34	
    35	Degree zero for the structure sheaf needs no separate statement: `H⁰(C_R, 𝒪) ≃+* R`
    36	on the nose (`AlgebraicGeometry.relStructureSectionsTop`), so its base change is
    37	`R ⊗_R R' ≃ R'`.
    38	
    39	## Implementation notes
    40	
    41	The overlap opens `V₀ᴿ ⊓ V₁ᴿ` (the `TwoCover.H1Cok` spelling) and
    42	`fst ⁻¹ᵁ (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)` (the base-change spelling) are definitionally equal; statements
    43	are given in the `H1Cok` spelling, and spelling adapters are introduced as local `have`s
    44	justified by `exact` where the two must meet. See
    45	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear` for the transparency option.
    46	-/

    51	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

    58	/-! ## Base change commutes with cokernels -/
    59	
    60	namespace LinearMap
    61	
    62	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    63	variable {M N : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    64	variable (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    65	
    66	private lemma ker_mkQ_baseChange :
    67	    LinearMap.ker ((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A) =
    68	      LinearMap.range (f.baseChange A) := by
    69	  apply LinearMap.exact_iff.mp
    70	  rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor, LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
    71	  exact lTensor_exact A (LinearMap.exact_map_mkQ_range f) (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
    72	
    73	private lemma surjective_mkQ_baseChange :
    74	    Function.Surjective ((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A) := by
    75	  rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
    76	  exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective A (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
    77	
    78	/-- **Base change commutes with cokernels**: for a linear map `f : M →ₗ[R] N` and an
    79	`R`-algebra `A`, the base change of the cokernel of `f` is the cokernel of the base
    80	change of `f`, `A`-linearly. Right-exactness of `A ⊗[R] -` in the two-term form consumed
    81	by the Čech-complex base change. -/
    82	noncomputable def quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv :
    83	    A ⊗[R] (N ⧸ LinearMap.range f) ≃ₗ[A]
    84	      (A ⊗[R] N) ⧸ LinearMap.range (f.baseChange A) :=
    85	  ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (ker_mkQ_baseChange A f).symm).trans
    86	    (((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A).quotKerEquivOfSurjective
    87	      (surjective_mkQ_baseChange A f))).symm
    88	
    89	@[simp]
    90	lemma quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv_tmul_mk (a : A) (n : N) :
    91	    quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv A f (a ⊗ₜ Submodule.Quotient.mk n) =
    92	      Submodule.Quotient.mk (a ⊗ₜ n) := by
    93	  rw [quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv, ← LinearEquiv.eq_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_symm,
    94	    LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Submodule.quotEquivOfEq_mk]
    95	  calc ((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A).quotKerEquivOfSurjective
    96	        (surjective_mkQ_baseChange A f) (Submodule.Quotient.mk (a ⊗ₜ n))
    97	      = ((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A) (a ⊗ₜ n) := rfl
    98	    _ = a ⊗ₜ Submodule.Quotient.mk n := by
    99	        rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
   100

   109	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   110	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
   111	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
   112	
   113	/-- **CBC-1, termwise**: base change of relative sections along the test-ring change
   114	`R → R'`, as an `R'`-linear equivalence
   115	`R' ⊗[R] Γ(C_R, V_R) ≃ₗ[R'] Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})` for a qcqs open `V ⊆ C.left`. Composite
   116	of the two free base-change identifications `relSectionsBaseChange` with the tensor
   117	cancellation `(R' ⊗[R] (R ⊗[k] -)) ≃ (R' ⊗[k] -)`. -/
   118	noncomputable def relTermBaseChange (V : C.left.Opens)
   119	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left)) :
   120	    R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≃ₗ[R']
   121	      Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
   122	  (LinearEquiv.baseChange R R' _ _ (relSectionsBaseChange C R hV hV').symm).trans
   123	    ((AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' Γ(C.left, V)).trans
   124	      (relSectionsBaseChange C R' hV hV'))
   125	
   126	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
   127	-- The `respectTransparency false` defeq checks through the `relCurve`/product spellings
   128	-- make elaboration exceed the default limit ...
   129	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   130	-- ... and the instance searches on the large tensor types exceed the default limit.
   131	/-- The termwise base change on a pure tensor: `r' ⊗ y` goes to the `R'`-action of `r'`
   132	on the compared section `relSectionsMap y`. -/
   133	lemma relTermBaseChange_tmul {V : C.left.Opens}
   134	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left))
   135	    (r' : R') (y : Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
   136	    relTermBaseChange C R R' V hV hV' (r' ⊗ₜ y) =
   137	      r' • relSectionsMap C R R' V y := by
   138	  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (relSectionsBaseChange C R hV hV').surjective y
   139	  rw [relTermBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.baseChange_tmul,
   140	    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
   141	  induction x with
   142	  | zero =>
   143	    simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, smul_zero]
   144	  | add x y hx hy =>
   145	    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
   146	  | tmul a s =>
   147	    rw [AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_tmul, relSectionsBaseChange_tmul,
   148	      relSectionsBaseChange_tmul, map_mul, relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap,
   149	      relSectionsMap_pullback, Scheme.overModule_smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul,
   150	      mul_assoc]
   151	    exact mul_left_comm _ _ _
   152	
   153	variable (D : C.left.AffineTwoCover)
   154	
   155	/-! ## CBC-1: the complex base-changes -/
   156	
   157	/-- The base change of the two-cover complex's degree-zero term: the product of the two
   158	chart-term equivalences, `R' ⊗[R] (Γ(V₀ᴿ) × Γ(V₁ᴿ)) ≃ₗ[R'] Γ(V₀ᴿ') × Γ(V₁ᴿ')`. -/
   159	noncomputable def relDiffDomBaseChange :
   160	    R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R D).V₀) ×
   161	        Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R D).V₁)) ≃ₗ[R']
   162	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCover C R' D).V₀) × Γ(relCurve C R', (relCover C R' D).V₁) :=
   163	  (TensorProduct.prodRight R R' R' _ _).trans
   164	    ((relTermBaseChange C R R' D.V₀ D.isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
   165	        D.isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated).prodCongr
   166	      (relTermBaseChange C R R' D.V₁ D.isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
   167	        D.isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated))
   168	
   169	/-- The overlap-term base change, in the `V₀ᴿ ⊓ V₁ᴿ` spelling of the two-cover
   170	carrier. -/
   171	noncomputable def relDiffCodBaseChange :
   172	    R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R D).V₁) ≃ₗ[R']
   173	      Γ(relCurve C R', (relCover C R' D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R' D).V₁) :=
   174	  relTermBaseChange C R R' (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) D.isAffineOpen_inf.isCompact
   175	    D.isAffineOpen_inf.isQuasiSeparated
   176	
   177	/-- The overlap-term base change on a pure tensor. -/
   178	lemma relDiffCodBaseChange_tmul (r' : R')
   179	    (y : Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R D).V₁)) :
   180	    relDiffCodBaseChange C R R' D (r' ⊗ₜ y) =
   181	      r' • relSectionsMap C R R' (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) y :=
   182	  relTermBaseChange_tmul C R R' D.isAffineOpen_inf.isCompact
   183	    D.isAffineOpen_inf.isQuasiSeparated r' y
   184	
   185	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
   186	-- Same limits as `relTermBaseChange_tmul`: the mixed-spelling defeq checks are heavy.
   187	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
   188	-- (Instance-search limit, same reason.)
   189	/-- **CBC-1 (the commuting square, pointwise)**: the base change of the two-cover
   190	restriction-difference map over `R` is carried to the restriction-difference map over
   191	`R'` under the term equivalences. -/
   192	lemma relDiffBaseChange
   193	    (x : R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R D).V₀) ×
   194	      Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R D).V₁))) :
   195	    relDiffCodBaseChange C R R' D
   196	      ((TwoCover.diff R (relCurve C R) (relCover C R D).V₀
   197	          (relCover C R D).V₁).baseChange R' x) =
   198	      TwoCover.diff R' (relCurve C R') (relCover C R' D).V₀ (relCover C R' D).V₁
   199	        (relDiffDomBaseChange C R R' D x) := by
   200	  induction x with
   201	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   202	  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
   203	  | tmul r' p =>
   204	    -- spelling adapters: the comparison map commutes with the two chart restrictions
   205	    have e₀ : relSectionsMap C R R' (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)
   206	        ((relCurve C R).resHom
   207	          (inf_le_left : (relCover C R D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R D).V₁ ≤
   208	            (relCover C R D).V₀) p.1) =
   209	        (relCurve C R').resHom
   210	          (inf_le_left : (relCover C R' D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R' D).V₁ ≤
   211	            (relCover C R' D).V₀)
   212	          (relSectionsMap C R R' D.V₀ p.1) :=
   213	      relSectionsMap_resHom C R R' inf_le_left p.1
   214	    have e₁ : relSectionsMap C R R' (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)
   215	        ((relCurve C R).resHom
   216	          (inf_le_right : (relCover C R D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R D).V₁ ≤
   217	            (relCover C R D).V₁) p.2) =
   218	        (relCurve C R').resHom
   219	          (inf_le_right : (relCover C R' D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R' D).V₁ ≤
   220	            (relCover C R' D).V₁)
   221	          (relSectionsMap C R R' D.V₁ p.2) :=
   222	      relSectionsMap_resHom C R R' inf_le_right p.2
   223	    have hres₀ : (relCurve C R').resHom
   224	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C R' D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R' D).V₁ ≤
   225	          (relCover C R' D).V₀)
   226	        (r' • relSectionsMap C R R' D.V₀ p.1) =
   227	        r' • (relCurve C R').resHom inf_le_left (relSectionsMap C R R' D.V₀ p.1) := by
   228	      rw [Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul, Scheme.overModule_smul_def]
   229	      congr 1
   230	      exact (relCurve C R').overAlgebraMap_apply_res R' (homOfLE _).op r'
   231	    have hres₁ : (relCurve C R').resHom
   232	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C R' D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R' D).V₁ ≤
   233	          (relCover C R' D).V₁)
   234	        (r' • relSectionsMap C R R' D.V₁ p.2) =
   235	        r' • (relCurve C R').resHom inf_le_right (relSectionsMap C R R' D.V₁ p.2) := by
   236	      rw [Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul, Scheme.overModule_smul_def]
   237	      congr 1
   238	      exact (relCurve C R').overAlgebraMap_apply_res R' (homOfLE _).op r'
   239	    have hdom : relDiffDomBaseChange C R R' D (r' ⊗ₜ p) =
   240	        (r' • relSectionsMap C R R' D.V₀ p.1, r' • relSectionsMap C R R' D.V₁ p.2) := by
   241	      rw [relDiffDomBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]
   242	      exact Prod.ext
   243	        (relTermBaseChange_tmul C R R' D.isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
   244	          D.isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated r' p.1)
   245	        (relTermBaseChange_tmul C R R' D.isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
   246	          D.isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated r' p.2)
   247	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, relDiffCodBaseChange_tmul, hdom]
   248	    simp only [TwoCover.diff_apply]
   249	    rw [map_sub, e₀, e₁, smul_sub]
   250	    exact congrArg₂ (· - ·) hres₀.symm hres₁.symm
   251	
   252	/-! ## CBC-2 (`i = 1`): base change of the two-cover `H¹` -/
   253	
   254	/-- The commuting square of CBC-1, in range form: the term equivalence over the overlap
   255	carries the range of the base-changed difference map onto the range of the difference
   256	map over `R'`. -/
   257	lemma relDiffBaseChange_range :
   258	    Submodule.map (relDiffCodBaseChange C R R' D : _ →ₗ[R'] _)
   259	      (LinearMap.range ((TwoCover.diff R (relCurve C R) (relCover C R D).V₀
   260	        (relCover C R D).V₁).baseChange R')) =
   261	      LinearMap.range (TwoCover.diff R' (relCurve C R') (relCover C R' D).V₀
   262	        (relCover C R' D).V₁) := by
   263	  have hcomp : (relDiffCodBaseChange C R R' D).toLinearMap.comp
   264	      ((TwoCover.diff R (relCurve C R) (relCover C R D).V₀
   265	        (relCover C R D).V₁).baseChange R') =
   266	      (TwoCover.diff R' (relCurve C R') (relCover C R' D).V₀
   267	        (relCover C R' D).V₁).comp (relDiffDomBaseChange C R R' D).toLinearMap :=
   268	    LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ relDiffBaseChange C R R' D x
   269	  rw [← LinearMap.range_comp, hcomp,
   270	    LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _ (LinearEquiv.range _)]
   271	
   272	/-- **CBC-2 (`i = 1`), cokernel form**: the two-cover `H¹` cokernel carrier of the
   273	structure sheaf base-changes along `R → R'`, unconditionally —
   274	`R' ⊗[R] H1Cok R (C_R) ≃ₗ[R'] H1Cok R' (C_{R'})` (the cokernel of the base-changed
   275	complex is the base change of the cokernel; right-exactness needs no flatness). -/
   276	noncomputable def relH1CokBaseChange :
   277	    R' ⊗[R] TwoCover.H1Cok R (relCurve C R) (relCover C R D).V₀ (relCover C R D).V₁
   278	      ≃ₗ[R']
   279	      TwoCover.H1Cok R' (relCurve C R') (relCover C R' D).V₀ (relCover C R' D).V₁ :=
   280	  (LinearMap.quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv R'
   281	    (TwoCover.diff R (relCurve C R) (relCover C R D).V₀ (relCover C R D).V₁)).trans
   282	    (Submodule.Quotient.equiv _ _ (relDiffCodBaseChange C R R' D)
   283	      (relDiffBaseChange_range C R R' D))
   284	
   285	/-- The `H¹` cokernel base change on the class of a pure tensor: `r' ⊗ [s]` goes to the
   286	class of `r' • relSectionsMap s`. -/
   287	lemma relH1CokBaseChange_tmul_mk (r' : R')
   288	    (s : Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R D).V₁)) :
   289	    relH1CokBaseChange C R R' D (r' ⊗ₜ Submodule.Quotient.mk s) =
   290	      Submodule.Quotient.mk (r' • relSectionsMap C R R' (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁) s) := by
   291	  rw [relH1CokBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
   292	    LinearMap.quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv_tmul_mk, Submodule.Quotient.equiv_apply,
   293	    Submodule.mapQ_apply]
   294	  exact congrArg Submodule.Quotient.mk (relDiffCodBaseChange_tmul C R R' D r' s)
   295	
   296	/-- **CBC-2 (`i = 1`)**: degree-one cohomology of the structure sheaf on the relative
   297	curve commutes with base change of the test ring, unconditionally —
   298	`R' ⊗[R] H¹(C_R, 𝒪) ≃ₗ[R'] H¹(C_{R'}, 𝒪)`, through the landed relative two-cover
   299	carrier `relTwoCoverH1`. The curve-lite form of Kleiman's *"cohomology commutes with
   300	flat base change"* for the structure sheaf in degree one (here without flatness, by
   301	right-exactness of the two-term complex's cokernel). -/
   302	noncomputable def relH1BaseChange :
   303	    R' ⊗[R] Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C R).moduleKSheaf R) 1 ≃ₗ[R']
   304	      Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C R').moduleKSheaf R') 1 :=
   305	  (LinearEquiv.baseChange R R' _ _ (relTwoCoverH1 C R D)).trans
   306	    ((relH1CokBaseChange C R R' D).trans (relTwoCoverH1 C R' D).symm)
   307	
   308	/-! ## Toward CBC-1/2 for the twisted sheaf
   309	
   310	The unit cocycle base-changes to a unit cocycle (`g ↦ g ⊗ 1`, units map to units), and
   311	the terms of the twisted two-cover complex base-change through the chart
   312	trivializations. **Frontier** (deliberately not built here): the compatibility of these
   313	term equivalences with the *twisted* restriction-difference map (the cocycle-conjugated
   314	analogue of `relDiffBaseChange`), hence `H¹` base change for `F_g`; it is the same
   315	`relSectionsMap` bookkeeping with one extra `g`-factor carried through
   316	`relSectionsMap.map_mul`. -/
   317	
   318	section Twisted
   319	
   320	variable (g : Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R D).V₁)ˣ)
   321	
   322	/-- **The unit cocycle base-changes**: the image of a two-cover unit cocycle on `C_R`
   323	under the sections comparison map is a unit cocycle on the base-changed two-cover of
   324	`C_{R'}` (`g ↦ g ⊗ 1`; units map to units). -/
   325	noncomputable def relCocycleBaseChange :
   326	    Γ(relCurve C R', (relCover C R' D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R' D).V₁)ˣ :=
   327	  Units.map (relSectionsMap C R R' (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)).toMonoidHom g
   328	
   329	/-- CBC-1 for the twisted sheaf, first chart term: sections of `F_g` over the first
   330	chart base-change onto sections of `F_{g ⊗ 1}`, through the chart trivializations and
   331	the structure-sheaf term base change. -/
   332	noncomputable def relTwistTermBaseChange₀ :
   333	    R' ⊗[R] ↥(twistSubmodule R (relCover C R D).V₀ (relCover C R D).V₁ g
   334	        (relCover C R D).V₀) ≃ₗ[R']
   335	      ↥(twistSubmodule R' (relCover C R' D).V₀ (relCover C R' D).V₁
   336	        (relCocycleBaseChange C R R' D g) (relCover C R' D).V₀) :=
   337	  (LinearEquiv.baseChange R R' _ _
   338	    (twistTriv₀ R (relCover C R D).V₀ (relCover C R D).V₁ g le_rfl)).trans
   339	    ((relTermBaseChange C R R' D.V₀ D.isAffineOpen₀.isCompact
   340	        D.isAffineOpen₀.isQuasiSeparated).trans
   341	      (twistTriv₀ R' (relCover C R' D).V₀ (relCover C R' D).V₁
   342	        (relCocycleBaseChange C R R' D g) le_rfl).symm)
   343	
   344	/-- CBC-1 for the twisted sheaf, second chart term. -/
   345	noncomputable def relTwistTermBaseChange₁ :
   346	    R' ⊗[R] ↥(twistSubmodule R (relCover C R D).V₀ (relCover C R D).V₁ g
   347	        (relCover C R D).V₁) ≃ₗ[R']
   348	      ↥(twistSubmodule R' (relCover C R' D).V₀ (relCover C R' D).V₁
   349	        (relCocycleBaseChange C R R' D g) (relCover C R' D).V₁) :=
   350	  (LinearEquiv.baseChange R R' _ _
   351	    (twistTriv₁ R (relCover C R D).V₀ (relCover C R D).V₁ g le_rfl)).trans
   352	    ((relTermBaseChange C R R' D.V₁ D.isAffineOpen₁.isCompact
   353	        D.isAffineOpen₁.isQuasiSeparated).trans
   354	      (twistTriv₁ R' (relCover C R' D).V₀ (relCover C R' D).V₁
   355	        (relCocycleBaseChange C R R' D g) le_rfl).symm)
   356	
   357	/-- CBC-1 for the twisted sheaf, overlap term (the term whose cokernel is the twisted
   358	`H¹` of `AlgebraicGeometry.relTwistTwoCoverH1`). -/
   359	noncomputable def relTwistOverlapBaseChange :
   360	    R' ⊗[R] ↥(twistSubmodule R (relCover C R D).V₀ (relCover C R D).V₁ g
   361	        ((relCover C R D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R D).V₁)) ≃ₗ[R']
   362	      ↥(twistSubmodule R' (relCover C R' D).V₀ (relCover C R' D).V₁
   363	        (relCocycleBaseChange C R R' D g)
   364	        ((relCover C R' D).V₀ ⊓ (relCover C R' D).V₁)) :=
   365	  (LinearEquiv.baseChange R R' _ _
   366	    (twistTriv₀ R (relCover C R D).V₀ (relCover C R D).V₁ g inf_le_left)).trans
   367	    ((relDiffCodBaseChange C R R' D).trans
   368	      (twistTriv₀ R' (relCover C R' D).V₀ (relCover C R' D).V₁
   369	        (relCocycleBaseChange C R R' D g) inf_le_left).symm)

     9	/-!
    10	# Restricting a scheme module to the base ring
    11	
    12	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, this file views an `X.Modules` object as a sheaf of
    13	`k`-modules.  The construction keeps the same section types and restriction maps; only the
    14	scalar action is restricted along `k -> Gamma(X, U)`.  It is the dialect bridge needed to
    15	compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
    16	cohomology engine.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    28	
    29	/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
    30	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    31	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    32	    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=
    33	  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)
    34	
    35	attribute [local instance] moduleKSections
    36	
    37	/-- The native structure-sheaf action, with section-notation binders kept explicit. -/
    38	private noncomputable def smulSection
    39	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    40	    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
    41	  r • x
    42	
    43	/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
    44	noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    45	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    46	    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
    47	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
    48	  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    49	    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
    50	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    51	      map_smul' := fun r x =>
    52	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
    53	          (congrArg
    54	            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
    55	              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
    56	            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
    57	  map_id U := by
    58	    ext x
    59	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
    60	      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
    61	  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    62	    ext x
    63	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
    64	      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x
    65	
    66	/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
    67	lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf
    68	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    69	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat)
    70	      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M) := by
    71	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
    72	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    73	      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl

    75	/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
    76	noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    77	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    78	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    79	  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩

    82	lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    83	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    84	    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    85	    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    86	    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =

   156	/-! ## The degree-zero term base change and the δ-naturality square -/
   157	
   158	/-- The base change of the two-cover degree-zero term `F(V₀ᴮ) × F(V₁ᴮ)`. -/
   159	noncomputable def datumDomBaseChange :
   160	    B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   161	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) ≃ₗ[B']
   162	      ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   163	        ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) :=
   164	  (TensorProduct.prodRight B B' B' _ _).trans
   165	    ((D.termBaseChange₀ B').prodCongr (D.termBaseChange₁ B'))
   166	
   167	/-- The degree-zero term base change on a pure tensor. -/
   168	lemma datumDomBaseChange_tmul (b' : B')
   169	    (p : (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   170	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) :
   171	    D.datumDomBaseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   172	      (D.termBaseChange₀ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.1), D.termBaseChange₁ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.2)) := by
   173	  rw [datumDomBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]
   174	  rfl

   176	set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
   177	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   178	/-- **The δ-naturality square** (the glued analogue of `relTwistDiffBaseChange`): the base
   179	change of the datum's Čech differential over `B` is carried to the datum's Čech differential
   180	over `B'` under the term identifications. There is no cocycle conjugation — the componentwise
   181	restrictions commute with `sectionsMap` through `gluedRes_sectionsMap`. -/
   182	theorem datumDiffBaseChange
   183	    (x : B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   184	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)))) :
   185	    D.termBaseChangeInf B' (((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' x) =
   186	      (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff (D.datumDomBaseChange B' x) := by
   187	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   188	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   189	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   190	  | tmul b' p =>
   191	    have hbc : ((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   192	        b' ⊗ₜ[B] (datumPair D).diff p := LinearMap.baseChange_tmul _ _ _
   193	    rw [hbc]
   194	    simp only [D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul B', TwoLatticePair.diff_apply,
   195	      D.termBaseChange₀_tmul B', D.termBaseChange₁_tmul B']
   196	    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub, D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B',
   197	      D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B', map_smul, map_smul]
   198	    congr 1
   199	    · congr 1
   200	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   201	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   202	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   203	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀)
   204	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   205	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   206	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   207	        p.1).symm
   208	    · congr 1
   209	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   210	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   211	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   212	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)
   213	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   214	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   215	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   216	        p.2).symm

   218	/-! ## The on-the-nose H⁰ base change and H¹ vanishing -/
   219	
   220	open AlgebraicJacobian
   221	
   222	/-- **`H⁰` base change on the nose** (DAT-1 (1d-ii) tail; the RE-5/DAT-B transport interface):
   223	on the vanishing locus, for every ring map `B → B'`,
   224	
   225	`B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D) ≃ₗ[B'] H⁰(C_{B'}, F_{D'})`
   226	
   227	with `D' = D.baseChange B'` — the abstract kernel clause `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` threaded
   228	through the term identifications by the δ-naturality square `datumDiffBaseChange`. -/
   229	noncomputable def datumH0BaseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   230	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   231	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 :=
   232	  (datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 B').trans
   233	    ((RigidEngine.kerCongr ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B')
   234	        ((datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff)
   235	        (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   236	        (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x)).trans
   237	      ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h0Equiv
   238	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   239	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   240	        (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).symm)
   241	
   242	/-- **`H¹` vanishes after base change** on the vanishing locus: the base-changed Čech
   243	differential is surjective (right-exactness of `B' ⊗[B] -` plus the δ-square), so `H¹` of the
   244	base-changed datum sheaf vanishes. -/
   245	theorem datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   246	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1) := by
   247	  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (datumPair D).diff :=
   248	    D.pairData.surjective_diff (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B (fiberTwoCover π))
   249	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B (fiberTwoCover π)) hH1
   250	  have hbc : Function.Surjective ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') := by
   251	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
   252	    exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective B' hsurj
   253	  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff :=
   254	    RigidEngine.surjective_congr _ _ (D.datumDomBaseChange B') (D.termBaseChangeInf B')
   255	      (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange B' x) hbc
   256	  haveI : Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).H1 := by
   257	    have h : (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).imageLattice = ⊤ := by
   258	      rw [← (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).range_diff_eq, LinearMap.range_eq_top]
   259	      exact hsurj'
   260	    rw [TwoLatticePair.H1, h]
   261	    infer_instance
   262	  exact ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h1Equiv
   263	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   264	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover π))
   265	    (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover π))).toEquiv.subsingleton
   266

     8	/-!
     9	# Base change of sections along the projection `C ⊗ Spec A ⟶ C`
    10	
    11	For an object `C` of `Over (Spec k)` (`k` a field), a commutative `k`-algebra `A`, and a
    12	quasi-compact quasi-separated open `V ⊆ C.left`, this file identifies the sections of the
    13	base change `(C ⊗ Spec A).left` over the preimage `V_A := (fst C (Spec A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V` of
    14	`V` under the first projection with the tensor product of the sections over `V`:
    15	
    16	`Γ(C.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+* Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k A).left, V_A)`
    17	
    18	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange`), sending `s ⊗ a` to the product of the two
    19	pullbacks (`sectionsBaseChange_tmul`), compatibly with restriction along `W ≤ V`
    20	(`sectionsBaseChange_naturality`). Here `C ⊗ T` is the cartesian-monoidal product of
    21	`Over (Spec k)`, realized by `Limits.pullback`; the single bridge lemma between the two
    22	languages is `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPullback_left`.
    23	
    24	This is brick 1 of the separatedness ledger (design §4.4): one brick, three consumers —
    25	étale separatedness (arbitrary `A`), the dual-numbers tangent engine (`A = k[ε]`), and the
    26	χ-ledger under field extension (`A = K`). Hence the statements are for an arbitrary
    27	commutative `k`-algebra `A`, and `V` is allowed to be any quasi-compact quasi-separated
    28	open (e.g. the intersection of two affines of the curve), not just an affine one.
    29	
    30	## Main declarations
    31	
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPullback_left` — the bridge: for `X T : Over S`, the scheme-level
    33	  square `(fst X T).left, (snd X T).left, X.hom, T.hom` is a pullback.
    34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.overSpec k A` — `Spec A` as an object of `Over (Spec k)`, together with
    35	  the instance `Flat (overSpec k A).hom` (automatic over a field).
    36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsAlgebra` — the `k`-algebra structure on `Γ(X.left, V)` by
    37	  restriction of scalars along the structure morphism. Deliberately **not** a global instance
    38	  (house rule, cf. `Scheme.overModule`); consumers activate it with
    39	  `attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra`.
    40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.resAlgHom` — restriction of sections as a `k`-algebra homomorphism.
    41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_sections_of_isAffineOpen`,
    42	  `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_sections` — the master pushout squares on sections, for
    43	  an arbitrary test object `T` with `T.left` affine (affine `V` needs no flatness; qcqs `V`
    44	  needs `[Flat T.hom]`).
    45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections` — the same square with the
    46	  `Γ(Spec k, ⊤)`/`Γ(Spec A, ⊤)` corners replaced by `k` and `A`.
    47	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChangeIso`, `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange`
    48	  — the comparison isomorphism (in `CommRingCat`, resp. as a ring equivalence), with the
    49	  computation rules `sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one`, `sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul`,
    50	  `sectionsBaseChange_tmul` and the restriction-naturality
    51	  `sectionsBaseChange_naturality`.
    52	
    53	## Implementation notes
    54	
    55	The heavy lifting is mathlib's `pushoutSection` API
    56	(`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Flat.lean`): for a pullback square of schemes the
    57	canonical map `Γ(X, Uₓ) ⊗[Γ(S, Uₛ)] Γ(T, Uₜ) ⟶ Γ(X ×ₛ T, ...)` is an isomorphism for
    58	affine `Uₛ, Uₜ` and qcqs `Uₓ` when `T ⟶ S` is flat — which over a field is automatic.
    59	This file only supplies the Over-category bridge, the corner bookkeeping (`ΓSpecIso`), and
    60	the tensor-product face.
    61	
    62	The `k`-linear faces consumers may need are one line away from `sectionsBaseChange`:
    63	it is `k`-algebra-compatible by `sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one` applied to
    64	`algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V) r` (both sides land in the structure-map image), and
    65	`A`-algebra-compatible by `sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul`.
    66	-/

    72	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TensorProduct
    73	
    74	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    75	
    76	section Bridge
    77	
    78	variable {S : Scheme.{u}}
    79	
    80	/-- **The bridge between the Over-category product and Scheme-level pullbacks.** For two
    81	objects `X, T` of `Over S`, the underlying scheme of the cartesian-monoidal product
    82	`(X ⊗ T).left` together with the two projections is the fibre product of `X.hom` and
    83	`T.hom`. This is the single point where `C ⊗ Spec A` is unfolded to `Limits.pullback`;
    84	everything downstream consumes this `IsPullback` datum. -/
    85	theorem Over.isPullback_left (X T : Over S) :
    86	    IsPullback (fst X T).left (snd X T).left X.hom T.hom := by
    87	  simp only [Over.fst_left, Over.snd_left]
    88	  exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback X.hom T.hom
    89	
    90	end Bridge

    94	variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

    96	/-- `Spec A` as an object of `Over (Spec k)`, for a commutative `k`-algebra `A`. -/
    97	noncomputable abbrev overSpec : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
    98	  Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))

   102	
   103	@[simp]
   104	lemma overSpec_hom :
   105	    (overSpec k A).hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) := rfl
   106	
   107	/-- The underlying scheme of `overSpec k A` is affine (it is `Spec A`); form usable where
   108	`IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (overSpec k A).left.Opens)` is expected. -/
   109	lemma isAffineOpen_top_overSpec : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (overSpec k A).left.Opens) :=
   110	  isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of A))

   112	/-- Over a field, `Spec A ⟶ Spec k` is flat, for every commutative `k`-algebra `A`. -/
   113	instance flat_overSpec_hom {k : Type u} [Field k] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
   114	    Flat (overSpec k A).hom :=
   115	  Flat.SpecMap_iff.mpr (by
   116	    rw [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
   117	    exact RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr inferInstance)

   119	end OverSpec

   121	section Pushout

   123	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (X T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   124	
   125	/-- **Base change of sections, affine opens.** For `X, T` over `Spec k` with `T.left`
   126	affine and an affine open `V ⊆ X.left`, the square of section rings
   127	
   128	```
   129	Γ(Spec k, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X.left, V)
   130	     |               |
   131	     ↓               ↓
   132	Γ(T.left, ⊤) ⟶ Γ((X ⊗ T).left, fst⁻¹ V)
   133	```
   134	
   135	is a pushout of commutative rings. No flatness is needed in the affine case. -/
   136	theorem Over.isPushout_sections_of_isAffineOpen
   137	    (hT : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : T.left.Opens)) {V : X.left.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
   138	    IsPushout (X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge))
   139	      (T.hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge)
   140	      ((fst X T).left.appLE V ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
   141	      ((snd X T).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   142	        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X T).left).ge)) := by
   143	  have hUST : (⊤ : T.left.Opens) ≤ T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
   144	    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge
   145	  have hUSX : V ≤ X.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
   146	    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge
   147	  have hUY : (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V =
   148	      (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (snd X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) := by
   149	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
   150	  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen (Over.isPullback_left X T) hUST hUSX hUY
   151	    (isAffineOpen_top _) hT hV
   152	  exact (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp h
   153	
   154	/-- **Base change of sections, qcqs opens.** For `X, T` over `Spec k` with `T.hom` flat,
   155	`T.left` affine, and a quasi-compact quasi-separated open `V ⊆ X.left` (e.g. an
   156	intersection of two affine opens of a separated scheme, or all of a proper curve), the
   157	square of section rings
   158	
   159	```
   160	Γ(Spec k, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X.left, V)
   161	     |               |
   162	     ↓               ↓
   163	Γ(T.left, ⊤) ⟶ Γ((X ⊗ T).left, fst⁻¹ V)
   164	```
   165	
   166	is a pushout of commutative rings. Flatness of `T.hom` holds automatically for
   167	`T = overSpec k A` (`AlgebraicGeometry.flat_overSpec_hom`). -/
   168	theorem Over.isPushout_sections [Flat T.hom] (hT : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : T.left.Opens))
   169	    {V : X.left.Opens} (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left))
   170	    (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
   171	    IsPushout (X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge))
   172	      (T.hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge)
   173	      ((fst X T).left.appLE V ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
   174	      ((snd X T).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   175	        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X T).left).ge)) := by
   176	  have hUST : (⊤ : T.left.Opens) ≤ T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
   177	    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge
   178	  have hUSX : V ≤ X.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
   179	    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge
   180	  have hUY : (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V =
   181	      (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (snd X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) := by
   182	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
   183	  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_flat_right
   184	    (Over.isPullback_left X T) hUST hUSX hUY (isAffineOpen_top _) hT hV hV'
   185	  exact (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp h
   186	
   187	end Pushout
   188	
   189	section TensorFace
   190	
   191	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   192	
   193	/-- The `k`-algebra structure on `Γ(X.left, V)` for `X` an object of `Over (Spec k)`:
   194	restriction of scalars along the structure morphism `X.hom`. Deliberately **not** a global
   195	instance (it would overlap with mathlib's `Algebra R Γ(Spec R, U)` instances; cf. the house
   196	rule for `Scheme.overModule`). Activate it locally with
   197	`attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra` — the statements of this file mention it
   198	explicitly, so consumers must activate the same instance for the statements to elaborate
   199	identically. -/
   200	@[reducible] noncomputable def Over.sectionsAlgebra (V : X.left.Opens) :
   201	    Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) :=
   202	  ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
   203	    X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge)).hom.toAlgebra
   204	
   205	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra
   206	
   207	/-- Unfolding lemma for `Over.sectionsAlgebra`: the algebra structure map, as a morphism of
   208	`CommRingCat`, is the structure morphism of `X` on sections. -/
   209	lemma Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections (V : X.left.Opens) :
   210	    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V)) =
   211	      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
   212	        X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge) :=
   213	  rfl
   214	
   215	/-- The algebra structure maps of `Over.sectionsAlgebra` intertwine restriction. -/
   216	lemma Over.algebraMap_sections_comp_res {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) :
   217	    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V)) ≫ X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op =
   218	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, W)) := by
   219	  rw [Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections, Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections, Category.assoc,
   220	    Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
   221	
   222	/-- Restriction of sections along `W ≤ V` as a `k`-algebra homomorphism (with the
   223	`Over.sectionsAlgebra` structures). -/
   224	noncomputable def Over.resAlgHom {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) :
   225	    Γ(X.left, V) →ₐ[k] Γ(X.left, W) where
   226	  __ := (X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   227	  commutes' r := congr($(Over.algebraMap_sections_comp_res X h).hom r)
   228	
   229	@[simp]
   230	lemma Over.resAlgHom_apply {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (s : Γ(X.left, V)) :
   231	    Over.resAlgHom X h s = X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s :=
   232	  rfl
   233	
   234	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   235	
   236	/-- **Base change of sections with the `k`/`A` corners.** For a qcqs open `V ⊆ X.left`, the
   237	square
   238	
   239	```
   240	   k    ⟶ Γ(X.left, V)
   241	   |         |
   242	   ↓         ↓
   243	   A    ⟶ Γ((X ⊗ Spec A).left, fst⁻¹ V)
   244	```
   245	
   246	(with the `Over.sectionsAlgebra` structure map on top and the second-projection pullback
   247	`A ≅ Γ(Spec A, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(..)` at the bottom) is a pushout of commutative rings. -/
   248	theorem Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections {V : X.left.Opens}
   249	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
   250	    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V)))
   251	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))
   252	      ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
   253	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
   254	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   255	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) := by
   256	  refine (Over.isPushout_sections X (overSpec k A)
   257	    (isAffineOpen_top_overSpec k A) hV hV').of_iso
   258	    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)) (Iso.refl _) (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)) (Iso.refl _)
   259	    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
   260	  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
   261	    rw [Over.ofHom_algebraMap_sections, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
   262	  · have h : (overSpec k A).hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (overSpec k A).hom).ge =
   263	        (overSpec k A).hom.appTop :=
   264	      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
   265	    rw [h, overSpec_hom]
   266	    exact Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))
   267	  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
   268	  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
   269	    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _).symm
   270	
   271	/-- **Base change of sections, comparison isomorphism** (in `CommRingCat`):
   272	`Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≅ Γ((X ⊗ Spec A).left, fst⁻¹ V)` for a qcqs open `V ⊆ X.left`.
   273	On pure tensors this is the product of the two pullbacks; see
   274	`Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul`. -/
   275	noncomputable def Over.sectionsBaseChangeIso {V : X.left.Opens}
   276	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
   277	    CommRingCat.of (Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) ≅
   278	      Γ((X ⊗ overSpec k A).left, (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
   279	  (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).isoIsPushout _ _
   280	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')
   281	
   282	/-- **Base change of sections** (brick 1 of the separatedness ledger, design §4.4): for `X`
   283	over the field `k`, a commutative `k`-algebra `A` and a qcqs open `V ⊆ X.left`, the ring
   284	equivalence `Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+* Γ((X ⊗ Spec A).left, fst⁻¹ V)`, sending `s ⊗ a` to
   285	the product of the pullbacks of `s` (along the first projection) and of `a` (along the
   286	second). The `k`-algebra structure on `Γ(X.left, V)` is `Over.sectionsAlgebra`. -/
   287	noncomputable def Over.sectionsBaseChange {V : X.left.Opens}
   288	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
   289	    Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+*
   290	      Γ((X ⊗ overSpec k A).left, (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
   291	  (Over.sectionsBaseChangeIso X A hV hV').commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   292	
   293	/-- `Over.sectionsBaseChange` for an affine open `V` (affine opens are qcqs) — the form
   294	pinned by design §4.4 brick 1. -/
   295	noncomputable def Over.sectionsBaseChangeOfIsAffineOpen {V : X.left.Opens}
   296	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
   297	    Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+*
   298	      Γ((X ⊗ overSpec k A).left, (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
   299	  Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV.isCompact hV.isQuasiSeparated
   300	
   301	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one {V : X.left.Opens}
   302	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
   303	    (s : Γ(X.left, V)) :
   304	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (s ⊗ₜ 1) =
   305	      (fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s :=
   306	  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).inl_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
   307	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')).hom s)
   308	
   309	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul {V : X.left.Opens}
   310	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) (a : A) :
   311	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (1 ⊗ₜ a) =
   312	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
   313	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   314	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) a :=
   315	  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).inr_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
   316	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')).hom a)
   317	
   318	/-- The base-change equivalence on a pure tensor: `s ⊗ a` goes to the product of the
   319	pullback of `s` along the first projection and the pullback of `a` along the second. -/
   320	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul {V : X.left.Opens}
   321	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
   322	    (s : Γ(X.left, V)) (a : A) :
   323	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (s ⊗ₜ a) =
   324	      (fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s *
   325	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
   326	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   327	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) a := by
   328	  have h : (s ⊗ₜ[k] a : Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) = (s ⊗ₜ 1) * (1 ⊗ₜ a) := by
   329	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
   330	  rw [h, map_mul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one, Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul]
   331	
   332	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   333	/-- **Naturality of the base-change equivalence in the open**: for `W ≤ V` (both qcqs),
   334	restricting the base-changed section is base-changing the restriction. The map on tensor
   335	products is `Algebra.TensorProduct.map` of the restriction `Over.resAlgHom` and the
   336	identity of `A`. -/
   337	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_naturality {V W : X.left.Opens}
   338	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
   339	    (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X.left)) (hW' : IsQuasiSeparated (W : Set X.left))
   340	    (hWV : W ≤ V) (x : Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) :
   341	    (X ⊗ overSpec k A).left.presheaf.map
   342	        (homOfLE (show (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤
   343	          (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V by gcongr)).op
   344	      (Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' x) =
   345	      Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hW hW'
   346	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Over.resAlgHom X hWV) (AlgHom.id k A) x) := by
   347	  induction x with
   348	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   349	  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
   350	  | tmul s a =>
   351	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, Over.resAlgHom_apply,
   352	      Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul, map_mul]
   353	    congr 1
   354	    · rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
   355	        Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
   356	    · rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
   357	
   358	end TensorFace
